legal_terms.required: Counsel-reviewed legal structure, Product RWA entitlement/Terms of Redemption, consumer protection, payments/PJP, tax/accounting/privacy applicability.

operating_economics.required: Verified supplier/production/QC/packaging/fulfillment/payment economics; assumptions are not actual performance.

inventory_reconciliation.required: Real inventory-to-token reconciliation with over-mint prevention and exception handling evidence.

refund_shortage_remedy.required: Return/refund/replacement and physical-stock shortage remedy tested without double claim.

settlement_tieout.required: Gross-payment to tax/gateway/refund/logistics/platform fee/net-owner settlement tie-out.

incident_backup_recovery.required: Incident response plus backup/restore/recovery tested for operational systems.

evidence_repository.required: Real evidence repository linked; no supplier quote, legal opinion, market proof, production result, customer demand or KPI may be fabricated.

note: These are external controlled gates. Change approved=true only with real public HTTPS evidence and the responsible owner/counsel approval.
